title: MONSTER V4 Step 5 — Terminal Proof Receipt
scope: Create one tamper-evident terminal proof object cryptographically binding the exact candidate SHA, authoritative workflow run, test count, required-lane results, exact scope diff, and freeze tokens. The receipt is proof-only and may not mutate product runtime or bypass existing lease, truth, frozen-artifact, or final-gate controls.
proof_policy: Freeze only after the exact PR head passes Terminal Proof Receipt self-test, permanent contract, all required DevSystem lanes and devsystem-final-gate; merge that exact head; then record one terminal receipt for the merged-main proof, register Step 5 artifacts in the authoritative frozen registry, advance the cross-chat truth packet, and release the distributed execution lease.
